context_for_next_testing_agent: V6.25.8 acceptance is GREEN. Key gotchas for next iter: (1) The login form on /login renders inputs WITHOUT explicit type='email'/'password' attributes so Playwright `input[type=email]` selectors fail — use `input[name=email]` or scrape testids first. (2) All campaign-tab/atelier-subtab navigation uses TEXT (no per-tab data-testid like `campaign-tab-atelier`) — use page.get_by_text('Atelier').first AFTER waiting ~3s for the page hydration. Adding stable `campaign-tab-{id}` and `atelier-subtab-{id}` testids would harden future automation. (3) The new V6.25.8 mod-rank shape is dict-only on save; if a tester finds an attribute that still writes bare strings, that's a regression — flag it.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial Playwright session reported all testids missing because the page never authenticated (input[type=email] selector mismatched the actual input element's lack of type attribute, so wait_for_selector timed out and the script continued into a logged-out state where all app testids are absent by design). Once verified that the underlying form renders correctly (screenshot-confirmed) and the backend round-trip works under raw fetch auth (cid + char_id both 200), it is clear the production app is working — the only finding is a small a11y opportunity to add input type attributes.
